name: Corridor conservative load experiment, 2026-09-29 accepted device sample

calibration.source: docs/WEB_PREVIEW_EXIT_CORRIDOR.md: 130-second device scheduling acceptance, 23 frame windows and 20 audio windows.
assumptions: Render load uses the largest window average, not a per-frame worst-case measurement.
Full LVGL refresh duration (50337 us) is conservatively charged again as a blocking transfer wait, not claimed as pure SPI time.
Frame period is a 110000 us experiment target, not the game timer configuration.
1440 mono-equivalent samples use the 6 x 240 descriptor geometry; effective playable headroom is unmeasured. The ring begins full.
Memory is the observed running-game free heap; only additional allocations are charged. Actual fragmentation is not modeled.
